tokens.v: The open lipstick stands like a player on a hand-built miniature handball court: color-blocked ground in dusty rose, persimmon and bone, painted lines running under hard noon sun so every element throws one crisp black shadow. 50mm at f/8 from just above court level, the bullet's dusty-rose tip aligned with the rose block. A miniature white bench and a tiny painted rope wall sit out of focus at the back line; the court's painted edge cuts the bottom-left corner. VERSE sits laser-etched on the metal collar, large and clean, catching the sun along its strokes.
